policy: Every entry ships with a recorded proof run (verify vs the original spec). A rewrite without a proof run is not added. Re-run proofs with: node bin/verify.mjs <before> <after>

rewrites.description: linear(a)(x) + linear(b)(x) -> linear(a+b)(x): two bias-free linears on the same input whose outputs are added fuse into one linear with summed weights.
rewrites.name: linear-branch-fusion
rewrites.preconditions: two unary linear layers (bias=false, same in/out dims, weights present) on the same input slot, consumed only by one binary add; intermediate slots private and not the output slot

proof.command: node bin/verify.mjs baseline.json rw_fused.json && node bin/opt_compare.mjs baseline.json rw_fused.json

rewrites.description: relu(relu(x)) -> relu(x): the second relu is a no-op.
rewrites.name: relu-idempotent
rewrites.preconditions: two chained unary relus where the intermediate slot is private to the chain

rewrites.description: add(a,b) -> add(b,a): canonicalizes operand order (no numeric change).
rewrites.name: add-commute
rewrites.preconditions: at least one binary add step with distinct operands
